items.question: Which five sectarian traditions are enumerated alongside the thus marker?
items.inference: The verse enumerates Shaiva, Shakta, Ganapatya, Saurya, and Svayambhuva traditions.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of the locative forms remains unresolved.
